title: Scrapegraph AI enables free web scraping with plain English #ScrapegraphAI #webscraping #opensource
description: Scrapegraph AI offers free web scraping without coding. This open-source Python library allows users to extract data from any website by simply providing a URL and describing the desired information in plain English. With over 30,000 stars on GitHub, Scrapegraph AI integrates smoothly with AI coding agents like Claude Code, making it ideal for lead generation, competitor monitoring, and research. Its ease of use and accessibility empower marketers, sales professionals, and curious users to gather web data efficiently without technical barriers. The tool exemplifies the growing trend of democratizing AI-powered data extraction, transforming how individuals access online information while reducing reliance on paid services and complex programming skills. #ScrapegraphAI #webscraping #opensource #PythonLibrary #ClaudeCode #AIAgents #leadgeneration #competitormonitoring #dataextraction #marketingtools #salesautomation #AItools #githubstars #researchautomation #nocode

hey bro nice work ❤
But what if i have to build a MultiSource E-Commerce product price comparison web app where a user just enters(inputs) a product name and our backend should search, find_candidate_urls(matched with that query product), fetch, scrape all the candidate_website's_product_pages(Amazon, eBay, local sites etc), extract the data and compare on our web app frontend.

Now one thing is clear that hard coded selectors for each e-commerce website will be a huge disadvantage and it will cost much time and will give us low speed etc.. So i want to build a Single Dynamic Multisource Scrapper without hardcoded selectors etc..
this will fit fine in this scenario? if not then please make me undertand what will work good
Please Let me know as i am building this as my Final Year Project for my Bachelors and i dont have enough time to manually build the whole system so i need your API. 😢
